slides.title: 5 phone myths you're probably still falling for

slides.fact: Apple says to force quit an app only when it's frozen. Background apps are suspended, and relaunching one can use more power than leaving it be.
It only stops your browser from saving history on your device. Websites, your employer or school, and your internet provider can still see your activity.

slides.myth: Drain your battery to zero before charging.
slides.fact: That's old advice from other battery types. Apple says you can plug in a lithium-ion battery whenever it's convenient.
Phones have a fix for that. Apple's Optimized Battery Charging waits near 80% and finishes before you wake up, to cut time spent fully charged.
Bars estimate how strong your link to the tower is. They don't show how busy the tower is, so full bars can still be slow.
